_comment: SF2/R5a: repo-declared PreToolUse hooks registered into the Brain's live ~/.ironclaude/brain/.claude/settings.json by _sync_brain_settings_hooks() at daemon start. The Brain loads these via setting_sources=[project,local]; the in-process can_use_tool callback is dead under bypassPermissions, so shell-hook registration is the live enforcement layer. The sync APPENDS each entry if absent (idempotent) and never clobbers existing PreToolUse/PostToolUse entries. Every referenced .sh is deployed from commander/hooks/ to ~/.claude/ironclaude-hooks/ (hook-logger.sh, a shared dependency they source, is deployed there by make deploy-hooks).
